supersedes.reason: Independent post-merge read-only Sol audit found three R2B blockers: the episode policy/hash output was incomplete, the public query field semantic type was incomplete, and the topology_viability schema/acceptance contract was incomplete. V3 was rejected before R2B and zero R2B artifacts were created.

review_governance.post_merge_audit: Independent Sol audit was valid for identifying the three v3 R2B blockers.
review_governance.pr89_claim: PR89's claim of an independent audit was unsupported because its assigned read-only auditor self-integrated the change.
review_governance.governance_breach: The self-integration is recorded as a governance breach and is distinct from the valid R2A observation/fold evidence and its independent scientific review.
review_governance.r2a_evidence: R2A remains valid and preserved; v4 changes contract-only declarations and does not invalidate accepted direct_observations.csv or group_folds.csv bytes.

r1_topology.decision: D-032 topology bytes and chemistry semantics are unchanged. D-034 promotes the frozen components only to a conservative reconstructed-family proxy for R2 grouping, folds, and episodes; they are not semantic lineage or mechanism families.

input_chain.raw_data_policy: Official data and generated outputs remain outside Git; every implementation must verify this input chain before reading labels.

row_contract.identity: source row identity, never a molecule-name-only aggregate

state_rules.missing: point, low, high, and std are all empty
state_rules.complete: point, low, high, and std are all present and finite, low <= point <= high, and std >= 0
state_rules.orphan_auxiliary: point is empty and at least one of low, high, or std is non-empty
state_rules.partial: point is finite, at least one auxiliary is empty, every present auxiliary is finite, any present std is nonnegative, any present low is <= point, and any present high is >= point

direct_compiler.invalid_input_policy: Fail before writing any output if a non-empty numeric cell is non-finite, std is negative, a present bound excludes the point, low exceeds high, or any receipt, source-row identity, molecule identity, standardized-structure, topology, or source-hash check fails.
direct_compiler.eligibility: Retain every state; only complete observations may serve as selector measurements, anchors, or direct local-pair support.
direct_compiler.observation_cardinality: Exactly one observation per molecule_id and endpoint is required after identity resolution; fail closed on zero or multiple observations.
semantic_firewall: Do not call them censoring, confidence, credible, or scoring intervals.
Do not derive TDI labels or infer hidden assay states.
Do not aggregate source rows before identity and state auditing.

local_pairs.relation: unordered pair of distinct direct-training identities in the same frozen D-032 similarity component and endpoint
local_pairs.remote_pair_policy: Do not use transitive remote pairs; an edge qualifies only from its exact pairwise similarity.

status_rules.LOCAL_SUPPORTED: at least 50 eligible components, at least 200 eligible pairs, and every frozen outer fold meets the declared fold minimum after implementation
status_rules.LOCAL_UNDERPOWERED: clean contract, identity, and leakage audit, but any LOCAL_SUPPORTED evidence threshold is not met; low sample support is never LOCAL_FAILED
status_rules.LOCAL_FAILED: a scientific or contract-integrity defect, including receipt, identity, state, chemistry, determinism, or leakage failure

local_pairs.experiment_order: The first local experiment is CYP3A4 only. Never tune topology or criteria to rescue another endpoint.

validation_contract.sha256: lowercase SHA256 hex of the exact validation_contract.json bytes, recorded at artifact build

r2a_validation_inputs.manifest_sha256: lowercase SHA256 hex of the exact receipt-bound R2A manifest bytes, recorded at artifact build

chemistry_policy.standardized_smiles: Recompute the frozen standardized SMILES from each raw structure, then assert equality with the receipt-bound standardized_structure_hash before fingerprinting.
chemistry_policy.component_policy: Use the unchanged D-032 connected-component hashes; recomputation is label-free and training-only.

minimum_fold_counts.status_rule: supported iff eligible_components >= 50, eligible_pairs >= 200, and every one of the exactly 15 fold-support cells meets both minima; otherwise a clean audit is LOCAL_UNDERPOWERED.

serialization.json: top-level JSON object with sort_keys=True, indent=2, and exactly one trailing newline
serialization.fold_support_cells: array sorted by repeat ascending then outer_fold ascending

topology_viability.failure_policy: Any receipt, raw-to-standardized chemistry, identity, fold, count, determinism, or authority defect aborts before creating the output directory and is recorded as LOCAL_FAILED in the experiment ledger; it is never emitted as authoritative topology_viability.json.
topology_viability.interpretation: The v4 topology viability schema and aggregate diagnostics are frozen, but no R2B artifact or prediction evidence exists until root independently reviews and replays the implementation.

campaign_episodes.repeat_expansion: Expand exactly the three frozen repeats; do not represent the three repeats times five outer-validation folds as fifteen episode contexts.
campaign_episodes.selector_reason: Released test parents were selected only from CYP1A2, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4.
campaign_episodes.anchor_rule: Within a selected component, choose the complete selector measurement with maximum point; tie-break by narrower reported span (high - low), then molecule_id.
campaign_episodes.episode_eligibility: The selected anchor must have at least one other direct-training identity with a non-empty finite point for any direct endpoint and exact anchor-query similarity >= 0.60.

query_rule.measurement: any direct point, regardless of completeness
query_rule.availability: After anchor selection, non-anchor measurement availability may determine query eligibility or score masks, but non-anchor measurement magnitudes cannot affect query eligibility or ranking.

campaign_episodes.isolation: A component may produce up to three selector episodes. Each episode receives only its own anchor projection; no episode may read another episode's anchor identity, labels, or cache.

random_anchor_stress.purpose: stress control only; never candidate selection, tuning, or fusion evidence
random_anchor_stress.eligible_set: complete selector observations in a primary-eligible component-selector cell that each have at least one query under the frozen query rule
random_anchor_stress.choice: choose the smallest tuple of SHA256('20260818|deterministic-random-anchor-stress-v1|' + component_hash + '|' + selector_cyp + '|' + molecule_id), then molecule_id
random_anchor_stress.episodes: exactly one stress episode per primary-eligible component-selector cell, using the same query rule and cap

campaign_episodes.weighting: Within each endpoint, every component-by-endpoint cell receives equal total weight; divide it equally across its selector episodes and then across scored queries.
campaign_episodes.stress_policy: Stress-anchor duplication is allowed for the declared control, but stress episodes are separate from primary evidence and never enter primary selection, weighting, tuning, or fusion.
campaign_episodes.primary_weighting: Weight selected primary episodes only; stress episodes receive no primary weight.

episode_id_policy.token_distinction: The selected_anchor and deterministic_random_anchor_stress tokens are distinct, so their IDs are distinct even when stress and selected anchors are the same molecule.

serialization.json: compact JSON with sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':')
serialization.arrays: Preserve query rank and array order; do not sort arrays.
serialization.csv_rows: Sort campaign_episodes_public.csv, campaign_episodes_truth.csv, and episode_label_masks.csv by episode_id ascending; corresponding rows must form exact one-to-one joins.
serialization.fold_indices: Encode repeat as the zero-based integer 0 through 2 and outer_fold as the zero-based integer 0 through 4.
serialization.json_artifacts: Serialize JSON artifacts with indent=2, sort_keys=True, and one trailing newline.
serialization.episode_id_uniqueness: All 1,122 expanded rows across selected_anchor and deterministic_random_anchor_stress must have unique episode_id values; duplicate IDs abort before output.

preliminary_diagnostics.interpretation: Counts are contract diagnostics, not prediction evidence.

identity_inference_diagnostic.interpretation: Public membership can permit identity inference; this is acknowledged and is not a secrecy or prediction-evidence claim.

public_csv_semantic_schema.storage: CSV cells are text; a narrow parser validates these semantic types before any episode output is accepted.

query_molecule_ids.items: nonempty molecule-ID strings in query-rank order

public_truth_firewall.disclosure_model: Exact-column/value nondisclosure and privilege separation, not information-theoretic identity anonymity.
public_truth_firewall.identity_inference: outer_group_id and query_molecule_ids may permit selector or anchor identity inference from public membership; this is acknowledged and is not treated as secrecy.
public_truth_firewall.public_artifact_role: Public episodes and their membership are oracle-only artifacts and must not be reused for inferred-anchor evaluation.
public_truth_firewall.selector_truth_policy: selector_cyp_truth remains scorer-only and is never a public or oracle-runner field.

campaign_episodes_truth.query_truth_references: Compact JSON array aligned exactly to public query_molecule_ids; each array element is an object mapping all four direct endpoints to that query molecule's exact observation IDs.
campaign_episodes_truth.query_truth_availability_masks: Compact JSON array aligned exactly to public query_molecule_ids and query_truth_references; each array element maps every direct endpoint to booleans for point, low, high, and std. A boolean is true exactly when that finite parsed field is present; references remain present when every mask value is false.

episode_label_masks.anchor_observation_references: Compact JSON object mapping all four direct endpoints to their exact observation IDs.
episode_label_masks.anchor_value_availability_mask: Compact JSON object mapping each endpoint to booleans for point, low, high, and std.
episode_label_masks.projection: The trusted runner receives public rows plus this mechanically restricted projection and never receives campaign_episodes_truth.csv.
episode_label_masks.loader: A narrow loader resolves only the four declared anchor observations through direct_observations.csv.

public_truth_firewall.serialization: Use campaign_episodes.serialization for every JSON-valued CSV cell.
public_truth_firewall.label_mask_rule: episode_label_masks.csv exposes only the selected anchor's exact direct-observation references and available-value mask. The runner resolves those references through direct_observations.csv; no other component member label is exposed.
public_truth_firewall.episode_exclusion: For each episode, every non-anchor component member is excluded from global labels, delta support, candidate pools, feature selection, calibration, and fusion.
public_truth_firewall.anchor_global_fit_policy: Under ANCHOR_EXPANSION_HOLDOUT, the designated anchor's available direct observations enter the episode-specific global training set as ordinary training rows and are also available as local context. Every other component member stays excluded. Global configuration, feature selection, calibration, stacking, and thresholds are selected only from inner cross-fitted training-group evidence.
public_truth_firewall.oracle_rule: The trusted oracle runner receives public rows plus only the mechanically restricted episode_label_masks.csv projection; it must never receive campaign_episodes_truth.csv, a complete truth row, or any scorer_only_field. Public membership identity inference is acknowledged, while exact selector, anchor, measurement, truth, and mask columns remain privilege-separated.
public_truth_firewall.inferred_candidate_pool: Deferred. candidate_pool_id must explicitly identify DEFERRED_NO_INFERRED_POOL_V1; never fabricate an inferred pool.

folds.group_unit: frozen D-032 similarity component, shared globally across endpoints and protocols as a conservative reconstructed-family proxy
folds.group_authority: D-034 grants these unchanged components grouping, fold, and episode authority for R2 only. This does not validate semantic lineage, mechanism, or complete analog-family recovery; publication claims must say reconstructed-family proxy until stronger evidence exists.

assignment_algorithm.group_weight: number of unique direct-training molecule identities in the component, independent of endpoint labels and availability
assignment_algorithm.group_order: sort by descending group_weight, then SHA256(seed + '|' + scope + '|group-order-v1|' + component_hash), then component_hash
assignment_algorithm.fold_choice: assign to the fold with smallest current molecule weight, then smallest SHA256(seed + '|' + scope + '|fold-tie-v1|' + component_hash + '|' + fold_index), then smallest fold_index
assignment_algorithm.inner_population: all components outside the selected outer fold; reuse the repeat seed with the scoped outer-fold identifier

folds.inner_assignment: Apply assignment_algorithm to the inner_population with four folds and the declared inner_scope; never use outer-validation information.
folds.availability_policy: Availability affects score masks and support reports only; it never reassigns a component.

protocols.GLOBAL_FAMILY_HOLDOUT: Hold each reconstructed-family proxy component wholly out of the evaluation boundary and expose none of its labels.
protocols.ANCHOR_EXPANSION_HOLDOUT: Hold each reconstructed-family proxy component out except for exactly one designated anchor exposed under anchor_global_fit_policy.

fold_support_minimum.purpose: A simple predeclared minimum for endpoint downgrade; do not regenerate topology or tune the minimum after observing outcomes.

activity_cliff.purpose: Diagnostic slice only; it does not alter pair eligibility, topology, folds, or fusion.

scorecard.weighting: Within each CYP, every component-by-endpoint cell receives equal total weight, divided across its episodes and then its scored queries; no large component may dominate.
scorecard.metric_authority: No metric implementation or scorer claim is frozen by R2.

future_artifacts.transductive_policy: No test-test relationships or transductive chemistry may enter any artifact.

required: raw direct strings and finite parsed values are preserved
all four state classes are represented and retained
identity and duplicate checks fail closed
no component crosses a fold boundary
official acceptance is run only after implementation review
leakage_invariants: GLOBAL_FAMILY_HOLDOUT exposes zero labels from its outer-validation reconstructed-family proxy component
ANCHOR_EXPANSION_HOLDOUT exposes exactly the designated anchor under anchor_global_fit_policy while every other component identity stays held out
after anchor selection, non-anchor measurement magnitudes cannot affect query eligibility or rank
all learned choices use cross-fitted predictions only
non-anchor component labels cannot reach an episode

r2b_success.joins: The three episode CSVs join one-to-one on unique episode_id sorted ascending; public query_molecule_ids are ordered compact JSON arrays and every truth query array preserves that exact order.
r2b_success.firewall: Public exclusions remain selector_cyp_truth, selector values, anchor identity, anchor values, truth values, query labels, and label masks. The trusted runner resolves only the four anchor observations from episode_label_masks.csv; every non-anchor family label is excluded from global labels, delta support, candidate pools, feature selection, calibration, and fusion.
r2b_success.topology_fold_cliff_diagnostics: The emitted topology_viability.json contains the exact four endpoint global eligible component/pair counts, all exactly 15 sorted fold-support cells per endpoint with their counts and minimum booleans, exact activity-cliff counts, and exact selected/stress/repeat/inference diagnostics frozen in this contract.
r2b_success.repeat_reproducibility: Two independent builds with identical verified bytes are byte-identical for every R2B artifact; output hashes are recorded in the manifest.
r2b_success.authority: The manifest matches authority_after_successful_r2b exactly; this remains below VALIDATION_FROZEN and grants no prediction, learned or fitted weight, metric, TDI, submission, or transductive authority.

authority.status_note: R2 v4 freezes the corrected contract only. It is not VALIDATION_FROZEN and cannot support scientific or competition claims. Contract-only authority remains denied until a successful R2B artifact build.

authority_after_successful_r2b.status_note: Successful R2B artifacts may carry fold, episode, episode-label, and topology-viability artifact authority only; this remains below VALIDATION_FROZEN and grants no model, metric, TDI, prediction, submission, or transductive authority.
